lines.t: I've been running circles, trying just to feel enough
Smiling for the world while I'm breaking underneath the stuff
Every little failure felt like weight I couldn't lift
Tell you I wish you a whisper, child, come rest a bit
I thought I had to fight alone Carry every storm on my own
But in the quiet I finally knew I wasn't meant to walk without you
When the world got heavy, he held me first Pulled me from the shadows when the fear got worse
All the pressure on me, yeah it almost hurt But mercy found me, he held me first
People see the brave face, never see the hidden tears
I was drowning in the silence, trying just to persevere
But he stepped into the darkness, lit a fire in the night
Turned my trembling to confidence, my weakness in my eye
I thought I had to fight all alone
Carry every storm on my own
But in the quiet I finally knew
I wasn't meant to walk without you
When the world got heavy, he held me first
Pulled me from the shadows when the fear got worse
All the pressure on me, yeah, it almost hurt
But mercy found me, he held me first
He held me first
He held me first
Many voices tell me who I gotta be
But yeah, we sure broke the noise
And said he's fighting right for me
Yeah, the world tried to shake me
Tried to get me reversed
But the king never left
Yeah, he held me first
Now I rise, now I breathe
With a fire in my chest, livin' fearless
Cause I know I'm fully loved and fully blessed
I don't bow to the pressure or the lies we heard
Cause you claimed me, healed me, held me first
In the silence, in the waiting
You were holding, you were shaping Every moment, every word
All my healing, you held me first
Yeah, you held me first
You held me first
